stories.title: Flintshire resident seeking 100% council tax rebate after bins not collected for six months
stories.summary: A resident on a Flintshire new-build housing estate which has not had a single bin collection for six months has requested a 100% council tax rebate as compensation. stories.summary: Inspectors found a paediatric area left unattended, medicine and equipment that had expired as far back as 2020 and patients being cared for in corridors at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd’s emergency department, according to a report published by Healthcare Inspectorate Wales. stories.title: Eryri rescue team responds to busiest month in its history
stories.summary: A mountain rescue team in Eryri has warned that a sharp rise in call-outs is “not sustainable,” after dealing with 59 incidents in August, its busiest month on record. stories.title: Family bids farewell as Pontybodkin hair salon Reflections closes
stories.summary: A hair salon that has been part of village life in Pontybodkin for nearly 40 years is closing, with the family behind it holding a farewell afternoon for clients old and new. stories.title: “I am absolutely appalled”: councillors lose fight against Flint HMO plan
stories.summary: Plans to turn a former council house in Flint into a four-person HMO for residents at risk of homelessness have been approved despite local objections. County Councillors Ian Roberts and Cllr Paul Cunningham spoke out against the proposals during a Flintshire Planning Committee meeting.
